l-e-e1-b06-40.title: Color things in picture
l-e-e1-b06-40.goal: For snow, leaf, apple color, consider all conditions and choose right one.
l-e-e1-b06-40.material: You color picture. Conditions: ① snow white ② leaf green ③ apple red.
l-e-e1-b06-40.s.s1.r.a: Snow and leaf colors switched. Break ① and ②.
l-e-e1-b06-40.s.s1.r.b: Leaf and apple switched. Break ② and ③.
l-e-e1-b06-40.s.s1.r.d: Snow and apple switched. Break ① and ③.
l-e-e1-b06-40.s.s1.explain: Only choice with snow white, leaf green, apple red keep all conditions.
l-e-e1-b06-40.s.s2.model.0: Snow white, leaf green, apple red, so all three.
l-e-e1-b06-40.s.s2.model.1: Other choices switch two colors, so only this one meet.

l-e-e1-b07-03.title: Choose words to ask for quiet
l-e-e1-b07-03.goal: For classroom quiet sign, consider conflicting conditions and choose phrase which meet all.
l-e-e1-b07-03.material: Teacher wan write sign board to ask everybody quiet. Conditions: polite, short (3 words), means be quiet.
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s1.r.a: Two words but no please, so no polite.
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s1.r.c: Polite, but 4 words, longer than allowed.
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s1.r.d: Polite and short but mean "sit down."
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s1.explain: "Please be quiet." get please, polite, 3 words, means keep quiet.
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: "Please be quiet." get polite please, three words, and means quiet.
l-e-e1-b07-03.s.s2.model.1: "Be quiet." no polite, and "Please be very quiet." get 4 words, so "Please be quiet" fit all.
